headline: Your leagues. Your teams. One feed. (account launch)
caption:
🆕 Your leagues. Your teams. One feed.

You can now create a free World Baseball News account and build your own baseball feed. Follow MLB, NPB, the KBO, the Caribbean winter leagues, the Hoofdklasse or any of the 40+ leagues we cover, add your favourite teams, and see the latest stories from all of them on one page.

How it works:
1️⃣ Create your free account (username, email, password)
2️⃣ Follow your leagues and teams
3️⃣ Read your personal feed, also on the homepage under "For you"

➡️ Swipe to see how it works.
👉 Create your free account via the link in our bio.

Which leagues and teams are you following first? Tell us below 👇

#baseball #worldbaseballnews #baseballnews #MLB #NPB #KBO #LIDOM #Hoofdklasse #InternationalBaseball #beisbol
